name: my_ts15
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing position stop-losses based on a Moving Average line and price distance parameters. It does not open any new positions itself but can close positions when the stop-loss exceeds a maximum allowed distance. The trailing logic dynamically adjusts between MA-based and price-based trailing depending on whether the position is in profit or loss.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个追踪止损工具，根据移动平均线和价格距离参数来修改已有持仓的止损位。它本身不开仓，但在止损超过最大允许距离时可以平仓。追踪逻辑根据持仓是否盈利，在MA追踪和价格追踪之间动态调整。
strategy_analysis: 这个EA的核心策略概念是利用移动平均线作为动态支撑/阻力来追踪止损，实现趋势跟踪式的利润保护。入场条件方面，该EA不负责开仓，仅管理已有持仓的止损。出场条件有两个：一是当价格触及动态追踪止损位时由止损单触发平仓，二是当持仓亏损超过max_sl点数且pre_init开启时强制平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数设置，仅修改已有仓位的止损和止盈。资金管理方面，max_sl参数提供了最大止损限制功能，防止单笔亏损过大。追踪止损逻辑区分盈利和亏损两种状态：盈利时使用较紧的trail_behind_price距离追踪，亏损时使用较宽的trail_behind_negative距离追踪，同时MA线作为另一个追踪基准，取两者中较优者。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is using a Moving Average as dynamic support/resistance to trail stop-losses, implementing trend-following profit protection. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open positions; it only manages stop-losses of existing positions. Exit conditions are twofold: first, when price hits the dynamically trailed stop-loss level, the position is closed by the SL order; second, when a position's loss exceeds max_sl points and pre_init is enabled, the position is forcibly closed. For position sizing, this EA does not handle lot sizes for new trades; it only modifies stop-loss and take-profit of existing positions. For money management, the max_sl parameter provides a maximum stop-loss cap to prevent excessive single-trade losses. The trailing stop logic distinguishes between profitable and losing states: when profitable, a tighter trail_behind_price distance is used; when in loss, a wider trail_behind_negative distance is applied, while the MA line serves as an alternative trailing benchmark, choosing the more favorable of the two.

parameters.description: 是否强制执行最大止损限制

parameters.description_en: Trailing stop points behind price when in profit

parameters.description_en: Trailing stop points behind price when at loss

parameters.name: trail_step
parameters.description: 追踪止损最小变动步长

pros: 双模式追踪止损：同时使用MA线和价格距离两个基准，取较优值，提供更灵活的止损保护
区分盈利/亏损状态：盈利时收紧追踪距离，亏损时放宽追踪距离，避免在回调中被过早止损出局
最大止损限制功能：pre_init和max_sl参数可以限制单笔最大亏损，具备基本的风控能力
支持多空双向：对多头和空头持仓分别实现对称的追踪止损逻辑
可视化MA线：可在图表上显示MA指标线，便于直观判断追踪止损位置
pros_en: Dual-mode trailing stop: uses both MA line and price distance as benchmarks, choosing the better value for more flexible stop protection
Profit/loss state differentiation: tightens trailing distance when profitable, widens it when losing, avoiding premature stop-outs during pullbacks
Maximum stop-loss cap: pre_init and max_sl parameters limit maximum single-trade loss, providing basic risk control
Bidirectional support: implements symmetric trailing stop logic for both long and short positions
Visual MA line: can display the MA indicator on the chart for intuitive judgment of trailing stop placement
cons: 没有新K线检查：每个tick都会执行追踪逻辑，可能导致频繁发送修改请求，增加服务器负担和被拒绝的风险
没有点差过滤：在点差较大时追踪止损可能被立即触发，导致不必要的止损出场
PositionModify返回值未检查：调用PositionModify后未验证是否成功，可能在静默失败中遗漏止损修改
仅支持当前图表品种：硬编码了_Symbol过滤，无法跨品种管理持仓
trail_step为0时可能导致每个tick都发送修改请求，即使止损位变化极小
cons_en: No new bar check: trailing logic executes on every tick, potentially sending frequent modification requests, increasing server load and rejection risk
No spread filter: with wide spreads, the trailing stop may be triggered immediately, causing unnecessary stop-outs
PositionModify return value unchecked: success of PositionModify calls is not verified, potentially missing stop-loss modifications through silent failures
Current symbol only: hardcoded _Symbol filter prevents cross-instrument position management
trail_step of 0 may cause modification requests on every tick even when stop-loss change is negligible
improvements: 添加新K线检查或最小时间间隔检查，避免每个tick都执行止损修改逻辑
检查PositionModify和PositionClose的返回值，处理交易请求失败的情况
添加点差过滤和最小止损距离检查，确保止损位符合经纪商的最小止损水平要求
添加OnTradeTransaction回调来监控止损修改是否真正执行成功
improvements_en: Add new bar check or minimum time interval check to avoid executing stop-loss modification logic on every tick
Check return values of PositionModify and PositionClose to handle trade request failures
Add spread filter and minimum stop-level distance check to ensure stop-loss complies with broker's minimum stop level requirements
Add OnTradeTransaction callback to monitor whether stop-loss modifications are actually executed successfully

risk_points: 每个tick执行止损修改可能导致频繁请求被服务器拒绝
未检查交易操作返回值，止损修改可能静默失败导致持仓缺少保护
强制平仓功能(pre_init)在快速行情中可能因滑点而无法按预期价格执行
risk_points_en: Executing stop-loss modifications on every tick may lead to frequent request rejections by the server
Unchecked trade operation return values mean stop-loss modifications may silently fail, leaving positions unprotected
The forced close feature (pre_init) may not execute at expected price during fast markets due to slippage
